note: Equirectangular. Row 0 is the north pole, column 0 is longitude -180. rgb = three bytes a pixel, base64. lum = one byte a pixel (the night lights, which are warm white anyway), with the floor and the peak the source actually reaches, since almost all of it is airglow.
source: Solar System Scope textures (https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/), CC BY 4.0, downsampled from 2048x1024
